name: Los Altos Community Services Volunteers
org: City of Los Altos, Community Services
what_you_do: Help at city events like Family Fun Days, the Spring Egg Hunt and summer concerts. Or help at the Adult 50+ Program with lunches, coffee, setup and games.
who_can_apply: Anyone at least 14. Volunteers under 18 need a parental permission form. The city takes individuals, groups, and families, one time or ongoing.
duration: One-time or ongoing shifts. Adult 50+ Program hours are weekdays, 9 a.m. to 2 p.m.
deadline_text: The city is accepting applications now. No deadline is listed.
how_to_apply: Print the volunteer form and fill it out. Bring it to the Los Altos Community Center (97 Hillview Ave), or email it to rec-info@losaltosca.gov. You can also mail or fax it. Staff will reach out to you. Ask Bridget Matheson: bmatheson@losaltosca.gov.
notes: The city's teen page sends teens ages 14 to 18 here. The Teen Center (grades 6 to 12, weekdays 3 to 6 p.m.) is a free place to hang out. It is not a volunteer job.
